title: Asked to blow the whistle because legacy program lacked oversight

tellings.quote: learning from people in that community that uh Congress needed whistleblowers that this was not being uh managed correctly

plain: Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon employee who became a whistleblower, says that around 2023 and 2024 people in that community told him Congress needed whistleblowers because a so-called legacy program, a long-running secret effort said to deal with UFOs, "was not being managed correctly." He says this is why he came forward, and if true it would mean such a program has run without proper oversight from Congress.
